column3: In order to undertake this quest, you must first meet the following requirements:

1. FINAL FANTASY XIV: Dawntrail must be registered to your service account.
2. You must be a beastmaster.
3. You must have befriended at least twenty-five beasts.
Lady Player! I have exciting news to share about the Crucible.
A new board has been added! One fit for only the most talented masters of combat.
Lady Lauda seems happier than ever. The souls of the Crucible are thriving, she says, and this new board affords ambitious beasts space to spread their wings─quite literally, where applicable!
Furthermore, I *distinctly* heard her mention that the final challenger will be a most formidable dragon known as “Borgny the Venomous.”
How's that for observation? I may yet be a fledgling of the craft, but you must admit that I have a keen sense for detail!
One day I shall be venturing into the Crucible beside you, Lady Player! Oh, what a day that will be... Until then, keep doing us proud!
The First Master's Board has been unlocked. To challenge it, speak with Lauda in Bentbranch Meadows.
Furthermore, new wares are now available from the Kornago merchant.
